title: Allow the immutable-x1 verification test in x2 staged scope
trigger_preconditions: an x2 change strengthens x1 commit verification
failure_signature: The first evidence-stage review rejected the updated v645-v4 x1 test because the allowlist named only the new x2 test, even though privacy and lifecycle checks were clean.
candidate_workaround: Bind lifecycle staged scope to the exact phase test set, including tests strengthened to inspect an immutable earlier commit.
recurrence_guard: Review every allowlist addition by exact path and require unchanged privacy and lifecycle checks.
rollback: Keep the evidence commit blocked if any test path is not phase-owned or if widening changes another gate.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local operational recovery only; no scientific, professional, authority, production, security-complete, accessibility-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
